slides.title: Used to / be used to / get used to
slides.subtitle: Three similar structures, three meanings
goals: **be used to + -ing / noun**: something is normal for you.
**get used to + -ing / noun**: the process of adapting.

head: Structure
Meaning
Example
rows: I**'m used to getting** up early.
